title: Compatible labelings induce edge assignments
statement: Let $q,k,n$ be natural numbers, and let a perfect matching in the complete $q$-partite graph with $k$ vertices in each part be equipped with a vertex labeling by $	ext{Fin }n$ that gives equal labels to the endpoints of every matching edge. The induced edge assignment sends each matching edge to the label of its chosen representative vertex.
hypotheses_covered: A perfect matching in the complete $q$-partite graph with $k$ vertices per part
The labels agree across every matching edge
